title: Single accountable owner
statement: Every valid lead in active work has exactly one accountable owner (an RM or a named queue owner) at any time.
rationale: Unowned leads were a hypothetical current-state problem (CSP-01).
stakeholders: Director, Business Banking Sales Strategy; Regional Sales Manager; Relationship Manager

title: Configurable operating standards
statement: Routing, SLA, capacity and duplicate rules are versioned configuration approved by the Director, not embedded code.
stakeholders: Director, Business Banking Sales Strategy; CRM and Technology

title: Timely follow-up
statement: Viable prospects receive first contact within the configured first-contact SLA for their channel and priority band.
stakeholders: Director, Business Banking Sales Strategy; Relationship Manager; Regional Sales Manager

title: Capacity-aware assignment
statement: Leads are not assigned to RMs at or above the hard capacity limit without an approved override.
stakeholders: Director, Business Banking Sales Strategy; Regional Sales Manager; Relationship Manager

title: Territory and specialist alignment
statement: Leads are routed to RMs covering their territory, and mandatory-specialist industries to specialists.
stakeholders: Director, Business Banking Sales Strategy; Relationship Manager

title: Controlled exceptions
statement: Every manual override, reassignment and escalation is recorded with a reason and actor role.
stakeholders: Director, Business Banking Sales Strategy; Regional Sales Manager

title: Clear closure
statement: Every terminal lead carries a disposition from the controlled catalog.
stakeholders: Director, Business Banking Sales Strategy; Marketing; Branch teams

title: Channel attribution
statement: Source and campaign attribution survives duplicate merges.
stakeholders: Director, Business Banking Sales Strategy; Marketing; Partner-management teams

title: Market context without override
statement: External market-opportunity context informs prioritization but never overrides validity, duplicate, eligibility, SLA, capacity or compliance controls.
rationale: Keeps the external score in its place.
stakeholders: Director, Business Banking Sales Strategy; Data and Analytics

title: Referral feedback
statement: Branch and partner referrers can see referral status and final disposition.
stakeholders: Director, Business Banking Sales Strategy; Branch teams; Partner-management teams

title: No inferred personal characteristics
statement: Routing uses service language only when explicitly stated and never infers language, identity or personal characteristics.
stakeholders: Director, Business Banking Sales Strategy; Relationship Manager

title: Existing clients excluded
statement: Businesses with an existing synthetic relationship are excluded from acquisition routing.
stakeholders: Director, Business Banking Sales Strategy; Relationship Manager

title: Channel required-field validation
statement: The process validates channel-specific required fields and moves incomplete leads to VALIDATION_PENDING.

title: Tiered duplicate screening
statement: Exact and high-confidence duplicates merge automatically; review-tier matches go to DUPLICATE_REVIEW.

title: SME eligibility gate
statement: Leads outside the 1-499 employee scope, outside Canada or in public administration become INVALID with an eligibility disposition.

title: Geographic resolution
statement: Leads resolve to an SGC 2021 CMA, a provincial remainder territory or a documented fallback.

title: Routing decision record
statement: Every routing evaluation records inputs, rule trace, outcome and rule version.
stakeholders: CRM and Technology; Data and Analytics

title: Assignment acknowledgement
statement: RMs acknowledge or decline each assignment; missing acknowledgement within SLA-05 triggers reassignment.

title: Contact attempt tracking
statement: Every contact attempt and two-way contact is recorded as an activity under the active assignment.
rationale: Slow first contact is invisible without timestamps (CSP-06).

title: SLA clock management
statement: Each SLA clock records its start event, target, warning, stop event and outcome.

title: Automatic reassignment
statement: Acknowledgement breach, repeated first-contact breach, inactivity escalation and RM unavailability trigger reassignment preserving prior ownership.

title: Escalation path
statement: Breached SLAs escalate to the Regional Sales Manager and, if unresolved, to the Director.

title: Lead lifecycle enforcement
statement: Lead statuses change only through transitions in lead_transition_rules; reopening only through the audited reopening event.

title: Qualification opens an opportunity
statement: Qualifying a lead creates exactly one opportunity; conversion requires a won opportunity.

title: Specialist fallback
statement: When no specialist has capacity for a mandatory-specialist lead, the lead is queued for specialists and escalated rather than given to a generalist.

title: Nurturing
statement: Contacted prospects not ready now can be nurtured with a scheduled next contact under the same owner.

title: RM-prospected self-assignment
statement: RM-prospected leads self-assign to the prospecting RM within capacity and territory.

title: Stated language handling
statement: When a service language is explicitly stated, routing prefers RMs supporting it; otherwise language plays no part.

title: Assignment history
statement: Assignments are retained as history with one row per assignment, prior owner and end reason.

title: Status history
statement: Every lead status change is stored with transition ID, event, time, actor and disposition.

title: Rule version on decisions
statement: Every routing decision, assignment, SLA event and capacity snapshot references a rule version.

title: Reviewed geographic and industry keys
statement: Leads, territories and specializations use SGC 2021 CMA codes and NAICS 2022 codes from analytics.dim_cma and analytics.dim_industry.

title: Market-context flag
statement: Every lead carries market_evidence_flag: full_framework, scale_only_limited_evidence or no_market_context.
rationale: Tier 3 and out-of-CMA leads stay visible.

title: Synthetic-only records
statement: Every CRM record is synthetic, marked record_source = synthetic_generator, with fictional contact values only.

title: Daily capacity snapshots
statement: Capacity is stored as one snapshot per RM per business day.

title: Separate opportunity record
statement: Each qualified lead has exactly one opportunity record, held separately from the lead, with its own status, product, owner and outcome.
rationale: Lead and opportunity statuses must not be mixed (CSP-10).
stakeholders: Director, Business Banking Sales Strategy; Data and Analytics

title: No invalid transitions
statement: No status-history row uses a (from, to) pair outside lead_transition_rules.

title: One active primary assignment
statement: No lead has more than one active primary assignment.

title: Terminal leads stop SLAs
statement: No terminal lead has an open first-contact or inactivity SLA clock.

title: Disposition validity
statement: Every disposition applies to the lead's terminal status.

title: Referential integrity
statement: All foreign keys in the CRM tables resolve, including CMA and industry keys in the analytical marts.

title: Timestamp order
statement: Lifecycle timestamps are ordered: captured <= ready <= assigned <= first contact <= qualified <= converted or closed.

title: Acquisition funnel reporting
statement: Report received, valid, assigned, contacted, qualified and converted leads by channel, market, segment and RM.

title: SLA performance reporting
statement: Report SLA compliance, breaches and escalations by SLA, channel, priority band, territory and RM.

title: Routing and capacity reporting
statement: Report territory and specialist match, utilization, overloads, overrides, reassignments and queue backlog.

title: Market-context reporting
statement: Report conversion by CMA with evidence tier and opportunity classification, keeping Tier 3 and no-context leads separate.
rationale: Links acquisition results to the external framework.

title: Data-quality reporting
statement: Report missing fields, invalid geography, unresolved industry, duplicate backlog, invalid transitions and multiple active assignments.

title: Determinism
statement: Given the same inputs, rule versions and random seed, the synthetic generator and routing evaluation produce identical outputs.

title: Privacy by design
statement: No real personal, business, contact or account data is created or stored; fictional contact fields are excluded from analytical marts.

title: Auditability
statement: Every override, reassignment, reopening and escalation is reconstructable from event history.

title: Local run time
statement: The full synthetic dataset builds and tests locally in the existing pipeline within 15 minutes on a laptop.

title: Business-time calculation
statement: SLA clocks use the configured business calendar, local time zone of the lead's province and holidays.

title: Production-scope exclusions
statement: No production integration, machine-learning model, dashboard or live data connection is built in this design.
